capturedAt.note: DX0.1 inventory of actual current commands, analyses, compiler outputs, lint/format operations, TypeInfo queries, semantic/flow facts, mappings, provider modes and editor clients. Canonical capability truth stays in roadmap/0.1.0-tama/catalogs/product-surface-catalog.toml; this inventory adds surface-level exposure facts, not a second catalog.

clients.launch: native verter-lsp over stdio; binary precedence e2e copy > setting > dev target > bundled > PATH; optional verter-mcp HTTP spawn
clients.capabilities: 16 contributed commands, virtual-file/source-map/component-tree/analysis/routes views, decorations, TS server plugin, MCP setup command

clients.kind: pure Lua config over the Neovim 0.11+ built-in LSP client
clients.launch: verter-lsp from PATH or cmd_path; --type-provider=<auto|tsgo|tsserver|off> with root strictly last; fail-closed on missing binary
clients.capabilities: shared six-key initOptions parity; opt-out semantic tokens; save-notify watcher replacement

clients.kind: languages.toml snippet for the built-in native LSP client
clients.launch: command verter-lsp, args --type-provider=tsgo; root via initialize workspaceFolders
clients.capabilities: six-key initOptions parity config table; vue/svelte language-server binding

clients.launch: PLUGIN_RPC.start_lsp once; serverPath override > opt-in PATH lookup > loud fail; shared argv with trailing workspace root
clients.capabilities: typeProvider clamp to tsgo|off; filtered serverArgs; six-key parity

clients.launch: language_server_command + initialization options; binary.path override > opt-in worktree PATH lookup > loud fail
clients.capabilities: binary.arguments/env merge; six-key parity; language-server-only manifest (no grammars)

preservedClients.rule: All five were checked before this constitution proposed anything. Replacement or retirement of any client requires its own charter and receiving amendment; DX0 proposes no replacement.

terminals.kind: npm launcher over the native Rust LSP server (crates/verter_lsp)
terminals.capabilities: LSP capabilities declared in crates/verter_lsp/src/capabilities.rs (hover, definition, typeDefinition, references, rename, push diagnostics, completion, semanticTokens full, formatting, onTypeFormatting, codeAction, codeLens, inlayHint, callHierarchy, workspaceSymbol, colorProvider, linkedEditingRange) plus custom methods

terminals.kind: npm launcher over the native Rust CLI (crates/verter_tsc); vue-tsc replacement
terminals.capabilities: -p/--project, -b/--build, --noEmit (default), declaration emit, --listFiles/--listEmittedFiles; tsgo-only engine >=7.0.2 <7.1.0, no tsc fallback

terminals.kind: npm launcher over the native Rust MCP server (crates/verter_mcp)
terminals.capabilities: agent tool surface defined by #[tool] handlers in crates/verter_mcp/src/server.rs (categories: summary, files, analysis, css, diagnostics, compilation, cross-file, runtime hints, refactoring, types, docs, routing, stores, ssr, baseline/testing); canonical table mcp/README.md

engines.compiler: @verter/wasm VerterHost (local bundle / GitHub nightly / jsDelivr selector)
engines.typescript: typescript@6.0.3 pinned in packages/playground/package.json, bundled into the Monaco web worker; never a CDN engine

operations: carrier/TS compile with JS/CSS output, SSR pass, per-stage timings
analysis snapshot (imports, bindings, template usage, CSS)
outline, code actions, CSS selector match matrix, template AST, CSS var flow, dependency graph, source map view
absent: tsgo or any TS>=7 engine (fail-closed; no WASM tsgo exists)
component-meta panel (removed; legacy URL modes remap to analysis)

format.lspSurface: structural-only SFC formatting; content formatting explicitly delegated to Prettier/dprint

userVisibleEdges: audited flow-return payloads via $/verter/audit/getRecord and getRecent

typeScriptPlugin.role: TS server plugin resolving .vue/.svelte carrier imports to *.verter.ts virtual files
